caption: The drawing depicts a geometric quilt design consisting of two large diamond-shaped patterns arranged vertically within a rectangular frame. Each diamond shape is composed of smaller squares and triangles in red, blue, and white colors. The squares are arranged to form star-like motifs, with areas of solid red, dark blue with white dots, and solid white. The upper diamond features an inner blue section with white squiggly lines, while the lower diamond is solid blue with white dots. The diamonds are connected at their tips by a series of alternating red and white squares, forming an hourglass-like composition. These central shapes are set against a green background filled with diagonal black dashed lines. The entire design has a wide border on the right and bottom edges, depicted in white with blue diagonal lines, framing the composition within the image. The background of the drawing is a plain, pale off-white color, and a signature is located at the bottom right corner. There are some light brown marks visible on the lower left edge of the image.
title: Quilt  - "Double Star"
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
